name: Jab
description: A quick strike that generates chi.

name: Tiger Palm
description: Strike with the palm, ignoring armor.

name: Blackout Kick
description: A powerful kick that consumes chi.

name: Rising Sun Kick
description: A devastating kick that weakens the enemy.

name: Fists of Fury
description: Channel a flurry of punches at all enemies in front.

name: Spinning Crane Kick
description: Spin in place, kicking all nearby enemies.

name: Roll
description: Roll forward quickly to evade or close distance.

name: Flying Serpent Kick
description: Leap through the air and kick where you land.

name: Touch of Death
description: Instantly kill an enemy with less health than you.

name: Paralysis
description: Incapacitate an enemy with a pressure point strike.

name: Expel Harm
description: Heal yourself and deal damage to a nearby enemy.

name: Fortifying Brew
description: Drink a brew that increases health and reduces damage.

name: Zen Meditation
description: Meditate to reduce damage taken.

name: Transcendence
description: Leave a spirit behind you can return to.

name: Detox
description: Remove poison and disease effects.

name: Soothing Mist
description: Channel healing mist at an ally.

name: Enveloping Mist
description: Wrap an ally in healing mist over time.

name: Renewing Mist
description: Place a mist that jumps between injured allies.

name: Storm, Earth, and Fire
description: Split into three spirits that attack different targets.

name: Touch of Karma
description: Absorb damage and redirect it to the enemy.
